facts.text: The hotel is set on a crescent bay in Grand Cul-de-Sac, St. Barts, in a beachfront location.
facts.excerpt: Set on a perfect crescent bay, our hotel in St Barts is refined and fresh, as elegant and restorative as its stunning beachfront location.

facts.text: Grand Cul de Sac beach is in the northeast of St Barts, 3 miles (about 5 km) from Gustavia and a short drive from the island's airport.
facts.excerpt: Located northeast of St Barts, this quiet beach is 3 miles (ca. 5 km) from Gustavia, a short drive from the island's airport.

facts.text: Grand Cul de Sac is a favorite beach for families thanks to its calm waves and smooth, shallow waters.
facts.excerpt: Grand Cul de Sac is one of the favorite beaches for families thanks to its calm waves and smooth, shallow waters

facts.text: The hotel has a serviced beach in Grand Cul de Sac with lounge chairs.
facts.excerpt: Our serviced beach in Grand Cul de Sac with comfortable lounge chairs

facts.text: Activities at the hotel's Water Sport house on Grand Cul-de-Sac Bay are included in the stay, with stand-up paddle boards, canoes and snorkeling equipment.
facts.excerpt: The Grand Cul-de-Sac Bay is the ideal place to relax and enjoy activities included in your stay at our Water Sport house. Relax and explore on a Stand-Up paddle board. Stroll on the water with our canoes for adventure.

facts.text: The interiors are by designer Sybille de Margerie.
facts.excerpt: With interiors by celebrated designer Sybille de Margerie

facts.text: Invisible drop-down screens turn the outdoor terraces into private, shady enclaves without blocking the view.
facts.excerpt: Invisible drop-down screens easily transform outdoor terraces into private enclaves, shady and comfortable but without disturbing the view.

facts.text: Rooms have in-room amenities by Diptyque.
facts.excerpt: the thoughtful integration of technology and in-room amenities by Diptyque

facts.text: La Suite Ocean Piscine Privee has a sprawling patio with a heated plunge pool.
facts.excerpt: from your own private enclave with a sprawling patio and heated plunge pool. Unwind in the blissful comfort of a king-sized bed in the La Suite Océan Piscine Privée.

facts.text: Le Duplex Ocean Plage spans two floors and is a private beachfront retreat a few steps from the beach.
facts.excerpt: The ravishing accommodation spanning throughout two floors, reserves a private beachfront retreat at the #1 Resort in the Caribbean, just a few steps away from the sunny beach.

facts.text: Le Barth Ocean Jacuzzi rooms have a spacious terrace with a private jacuzzi.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy special moments in our Le Barth Océan Jacuzzi room, the perfect romantic setting with a spacious terrace with a private jacuzzi to relax and unwind.

facts.text: Some Junior Suite Ocean rooms can be connected to create a large two-bedroom suite for families.
facts.excerpt: Le Barthélemy offers the option to connect to some Junior Suite Océan rooms, to create a large, two-bedroom suite, perfect for luxury family vacations.

facts.text: La Suite Signature Plage has direct access to the beach and is available on a 1, 2 or 3-bedroom basis.
facts.excerpt: This luxury suite is available on a 1, 2 or 3-bedroom basis depending on the number of guests.

facts.text: The spa is Le B. Spa by Augustinus Bader.
facts.excerpt: Immerse yourself in a haven of peace where Le B. Spa by Augustinus Bader awaits you for a revitalizing journey.

facts.text: Le B. Spa has an open-air atrium that brings the outdoors in.
facts.excerpt: beginning with its soothing Caribbean setting and open-air atrium that invites the outdoors in

facts.text: The spa's Vitality Pools are three tubs: one warm tub and two cold tubs.
facts.excerpt: Our Vitality Pools are composed of 3 tubs : 1 warm tub at 100 °F and two cold tubs of 52°F and 41°F

facts.text: The spa offers a hammam and a sauna.
facts.excerpt: Originally from the Middle East where beauty rituals are lavished, the hammam helps to purify and cleanse the skin

facts.text: The Longevity Experience is led by Longevity Doctor Franck Baudino and his team, with a personalized health assessment and tailored protocol.
facts.excerpt: Our Longevity Doctor, Franck Baudino, and his team of experts, conduct an ultra-personalized health assessment and create a tailored protocol

facts.text: There is a fully equipped fitness center and group yoga classes.
facts.excerpt: Energize yourself at our fully equipped, state-of-the-art fitness center or take one of our purifying group yoga classes

facts.text: Amis St. Barth is a seaside French beach restaurant serving lunch daily and brunch on Sundays.
facts.excerpt: Offering lunch daily and now brunch on Sundays, Amis is a celebration of fresh, wholesome ingredients shared in good company.

facts.text: Seven Stars Bar blends astrology and art, with crafted cocktails.
facts.excerpt: the Seven Stars Bar offers a touch of mystique, blending astrology and art in a setting where expertly crafted cocktails take you on a voyage through the cosmos

facts.text: The hotel's Guest Experience Makers can help with internal flights to St. Barthelemy.
facts.excerpt: our GEMs (Guest Experience Makers) are happy to assist with internal flights to St. Barthélemy.

facts.text: Travel + Leisure named the hotel among the Top 100 Hotels in the World's Best Awards 2026 and ranked it the 3rd best resort in the Caribbean.
facts.excerpt: Le Barthélemy Hotel & Spa has been named among the Top 100 Hotels in the World’s Best Awards 2026 and ranked the 3rd Best Resort in the Caribbean by Travel + Leisure.

facts.text: The hotel was named the number one resort in the Caribbean by the Conde Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards in 2022, 2020 and 2018.
facts.excerpt: having been named the #1 Resort in the Caribbean in 2022, 2020 and 2018

facts.text: St Barthelemy is reached by plane or via direct links from neighboring islands.
facts.excerpt: Easily accessible by plane or via direct links from neighboring islands
